Lena (growth): Quick checklist before we flip redirects for the webinar consolidation: permanent redirects, landing JSON-LD, internal anchor updates, and 48h watch for 404 spikes. Keep it minimal.

Omar (seo): Agree. Plan: 1) 301 legacy promos -> /webinar-consolidated-2026 2) set canonical self on new landing 3) add Event + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD in <head> 4) update 6 pillar pages with contextual anchors to benchmarks/pricing/docs.

Vik (eng): Need exact legacy paths + param policy. Also shortlink behavior (/x/webinar).

Maya (content): Legacy list: /promo/old-demo, /events/live-old, /blog/what-to-expect. Shortlink /x/webinar. Preserve utm_source and utm_campaign; strip session_id and legacy_ref.

Vik (eng): Nginx snippets for staging: ```location = /promo/old-demo { return 301 https://redwood.inference/webinar-consolidated-2026?$query_string; } rewrite ^/events/live-old(.*)$ /webinar-consolidated-2026$1 permanent; location = /x/webinar { return 302 https://redwood.inference/webinar-consolidated-2026; }``` Will flip /x/webinar to 301 after 72h.

monitor-bot: Staging redirect deploy scheduled at 2026-08-02T14:00:00Z.

Omar (seo): JSON-LD (place on landing head): ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving at Scale: Redwood Webinar","startDate":"2026-08-02T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-consolidated-2026","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}``` Add BreadcrumbList too.

Maya (content): I'll push anchor CSV to the drive: /benchmarks -> "inference benchmarks", /pricing -> "cost of inference", /docs/optimize -> "reduce token spend". Also staging CTA copy variants ready: A) "Watch demo" B) "See latency & cost benchmarks" (60/40 to benchmarks).

Lena (growth): QA checklist post-deploy: crawl to confirm 301s, validate structured data, check canonical, ensure form captures utm_campaign, run internal link report, monitor 404 alerts.

Vik (eng): Rollback plan: comment redirect blocks, reload nginx, purge CDN. Tagging eng-oncall for 48h. I'll open PR and tag this thread.

Lena (growth): Owners: redirects=Vik, anchors=Maya, schema=Omar, monitoring=eng-oncall. Keep changes small and report back 48h. :white_check_mark:
